concepts.name: 〜が／けど（逆接）
concepts.def: Connects a contrasting or unexpected statement to what comes before it. The different forms vary in politeness and conversational tone.

concepts.name: Nがほしい
concepts.def: Expresses the speaker's desire to have or obtain something, such as an object, a person, or time.

concepts.name: 〜ている／〜ています
concepts.def: Adds iru or imasu to a verb's te-form to express an action in progress, a repeated habit, an ongoing state, or a state resulting from a change.

concepts.name: ～てから
concepts.def: Shows a clear sequence in which one action is performed after the preceding action has finished.

concepts.name: 〜てください（依頼・指示）
concepts.def: Used to politely ask or instruct someone to perform an action.

concepts.name: 〜ましょう
concepts.def: Proposes or invites an action involving the listener, or expresses the speaker's intention to perform it.

concepts.name: 〜ませんか
concepts.def: Politely invites someone to do something or suggests doing it together.

concepts.name: 〜ながら
concepts.def: Expresses that the same person performs two actions at the same time.

concepts.name: 動詞の辞書形
concepts.def: The basic verb form found in dictionaries. It is used for affirmative non-past statements in plain style and before many grammar patterns.

concepts.name: 名詞修飾節
concepts.def: Places a plain-form clause before a noun to explain in more detail what kind of person, object, or thing it is.

concepts.name: ～から（理由）
concepts.def: Places the reason or cause for a judgment or action before kara.

concepts.name: ～たいです
concepts.def: Expresses an action that the speaker wants to do or wishes to do.

concepts.name: ～て、～ます
concepts.def: Links multiple actions with the te-form and states them in the order they occur. The final verb determines the tense of the whole sentence.

concepts.name: Nがある／いる（存在）
concepts.def: States that a person, animal, object, or event exists. Iru is used for people and animals, while aru is used for objects, plants, and events.

concepts.name: 〜か（疑問）
concepts.def: Added to the end of a sentence to form a question asking for information, a judgment, or a choice.

concepts.name: 〜ね（確認・共有）
concepts.def: Assumes that the listener shares the same information or feeling and seeks confirmation, agreement, or empathy.

concepts.name: 〜よ（新情報・注意喚起）
concepts.def: Clearly conveys information the listener may not know, the speaker's judgment, or a warning.

concepts.name: 動詞ます形の時制
concepts.def: Shows the polite affirmative and negative verb forms in both the non-past and past tenses.

concepts.name: い形容詞
concepts.def: Describes the quality or state of something. The final i changes to form the negative and past forms.

concepts.name: ～でした / ～ではありませんでした
concepts.def: Shows the polite affirmative and negative predicate forms of na-adjectives and nouns in both the non-past and past tenses.

concepts.name: ～まえに
concepts.def: Expresses that one action is performed before another action or event.

concepts.name: 〜たあとで／〜のあとで
concepts.def: Expresses that one action is performed after another action or event has finished.

concepts.name: 疑問詞＋か（不定）
concepts.def: Adds ka to a question word to refer to an unspecified person, object, place, time, or other item.

concepts.name: 何も〜ません
concepts.def: Combines a question word with mo and a negative form to express that there is not even one person, object, place, or other item.

concepts.name: い形容詞の名詞化（〜の）
concepts.def: Replaces a noun already mentioned or understood from context with no, avoiding repetition of the same noun.

concepts.name: ～たり、～たり
concepts.def: Lists representative examples from among several actions or states.

concepts.name: ～から、～まで
concepts.def: Marks the starting point of a range with kara and its endpoint with made for time, place, quantity, and other ranges.

concepts.name: ～だけ
concepts.def: Limits a person, object, quantity, or range and indicates that nothing else is included.

concepts.name: 〜しか〜ない（限定）
concepts.def: Limits a quantity or range to only that amount and often conveys the speaker's feeling that it is small or insufficient.

concepts.name: 〜ないでください（否定の依頼・禁止）
concepts.def: Politely asks or instructs someone not to perform an action.

concepts.name: あまり〜ません
concepts.def: Combines with a negative expression to indicate that the degree or frequency is not high.

concepts.name: どれくらい／どのぐらい
concepts.def: Asks about or indicates an approximate amount of time, number of people, distance, or other quantity.

concepts.name: 〜ごろ
concepts.def: Indicates that a time or period is approximate.

concepts.name: NやN（など）（非網羅的な例示）
concepts.def: Gives representative examples from the same category and indicates that other similar items also exist.

concepts.name: NとN／NとV（並列・共同）
concepts.def: Uses to to list nouns exhaustively or to indicate the person with whom an action is performed.

concepts.name: 助詞「で」（場所・手段・材料・範囲）
concepts.def: Attaches the particle de to a noun to indicate the place of an action, a means or tool, a material, the number of participants, a range, and similar information.

concepts.name: NのN（所属・種類・関係）
concepts.def: Connects two nouns with no so that the first noun specifies the second through possession, ownership, type, content, location, or another relationship.

concepts.name: い形容詞の副詞用法（〜く）
concepts.def: Changes an i-adjective to -ku or a na-adjective to -ni to describe the manner or degree of an action.

concepts.name: ～なる
concepts.def: Expresses a change in a person's or thing's quality, state, position, or other condition.

concepts.name: 〜くする
concepts.def: Expresses intentionally changing the state of something or choosing one item from several options.

concepts.name: 〜てある（結果状態）
concepts.def: Describes a state that remains as the result of someone's intentional action. The focus is on the resulting state, so the person who performed the action is usually omitted.

concepts.name: 〜というN
concepts.def: Places the name of a person, shop, object, or place before to iu to indicate what the following noun is called.

concepts.name: ～でしょう
concepts.def: Expresses the speaker's conjecture or a prediction about what will happen.

concepts.name: 〜てくださいませんか（丁寧な依頼）
concepts.def: Uses a negative question to make a reserved and polite request for someone to perform an action.

concepts.name: ～にいく
concepts.def: Expresses going, coming, or returning somewhere for the purpose of performing an action.

concepts.name: もう＋Vました（完了）
concepts.def: Indicates that an action or change has already been completed by the time of speaking.

concepts.name: まだ＋Vていません（未完了）
concepts.def: Indicates that an action has not been completed at the present time but may be performed later.

concepts.name: ～とき
concepts.def: Indicates the time or situation in which an action or state occurs.

concepts.name: 〜ましょうか（申し出・提案）
concepts.def: Offers to do something or proposes doing something together with the listener.

concepts.name: 〜ないで（付帯状況）
concepts.def: Expresses performing one action while not performing another action.

concepts.name: Nをください（物の依頼）
concepts.def: Names a desired item and asks someone to give it to the speaker.

concepts.name: 〜と言います
concepts.def: Places the content of what someone said or asked before to and quotes it with verbs such as iu or kiku.

concepts.name: 〜方（方法）
concepts.def: Turns the method or procedure for performing an action into a noun meaning 'the way to do something.'

concepts.name: 〜で〜がいちばん（最上級）
concepts.def: Expresses that a person, object, or matter has the highest degree within a given range.

concepts.name: Nはどうですか（感想質問・提案）
concepts.def: Asks for the listener's opinion or condition regarding a topic, or gently suggests an object or action.

concepts.name: 〜は〜ません
concepts.def: Introduces the noun before wa as the topic and follows it with an explanation. It can also contrast that noun with something else.

concepts.name: Nが〜（主語・対象）
concepts.def: Marks the subject of a sentence or a person, object, or matter that the speaker is presenting as new information.

concepts.name: 助詞「を」（対象・経路・離点）
concepts.def: Uses the particle o to mark the direct object of an action, a route traveled, or a place being left.

concepts.name: Nに（時・着点・相手・存在場所）
concepts.def: Uses the particle ni to indicate the time of an action, a destination, the other party or recipient of an action, or the location where a person or thing exists.

concepts.name: Nへ（方向）
concepts.def: Indicates a direction or destination and is used with movement verbs such as iku, kuru, and kaeru.

concepts.name: 〜も〜も
concepts.def: Adds another person, object, or matter of the same kind as one already mentioned, or indicates that several things share the same quality.

concepts.name: AはBが〜（属性・能力・好悪）
concepts.def: Marks the topic with A wa and uses B ga to identify a part of that topic, an ability, an object of likes or dislikes, or another attribute.

concepts.name: い形容詞〜くなくて
concepts.def: Links adjective or noun predicates to list qualities and states, or presents the first state as the reason for the result that follows.

concepts.name: 動詞て形
concepts.def: A basic verb conjugation used to connect a verb to another verb or particle. It forms the basis of many patterns expressing sequence, requests, ongoing actions, permission, and more.

concepts.name: 動詞ない形
concepts.def: The plain non-past negative verb form, also used before patterns such as naide and nakereba.

concepts.name: 動詞た形
concepts.def: The plain past affirmative verb form, also used before patterns such as ta koto ga aru and ta ato de.

concepts.name: 動詞の普通形
concepts.def: The set of basic verb forms that do not use desu or masu. Its four forms—non-past affirmative, non-past negative, past affirmative, and past negative—connect to patterns such as noun modification and quotation.

concepts.name: 〜こと／〜の（名詞化）
concepts.def: Treats the content of a verb or adjective like a noun by adding koto or no. It is used to discuss preferences, abilities, experiences, facts, and similar matters.

concepts.name: 〜か〜
concepts.def: Connects two or more alternatives with ka to indicate that one of them applies or to express a choice.

concepts.name: どちら／どっち
concepts.def: Asks which of two things applies or uses a question word to ask about the listener's preference or choice. Dochira is more polite than docchi.

concepts.name: 〜かどうか
concepts.def: Embeds uncertainty about whether something is or is not the case as part of a sentence.

concepts.name: 〜かもしれない
concepts.def: Makes a reserved guess that something is possible, although it is not certain.

concepts.name: 〜だろう
concepts.def: Expresses a judgment that something is likely based on the situation or available evidence.

concepts.name: 〜なくてもいい
concepts.def: Indicates that there is no need or obligation to perform an action and that not doing it is acceptable.

concepts.name: 〜なら
concepts.def: Takes a topic raised by the listener or a hypothetical situation as a condition, then gives a judgment, advice, wish, or other response for that case.

concepts.name: ～のに
concepts.def: Shows that the actual result differs from what was expected, often conveying surprise, dissatisfaction, or regret.

concepts.name: 〜ば（条件）
concepts.def: The conjugated verb or adjective form used to connect to the conditional ba.

concepts.name: 〜ことにする
concepts.def: Expresses a decision made by the speaker after consideration. Koto ni shite iru describes a self-imposed habit or policy that the speaker continues to follow.

concepts.name: ～ておく
concepts.def: Expresses doing something in advance for the future or leaving a state as it is.

concepts.name: ～てしまう
concepts.def: Expresses the completion of an action or regret about an unintended result.

concepts.name: ～し、〜し
concepts.def: Lists multiple reasons, characteristics, or facts as grounds for a judgment or explanation.

concepts.name: 〜って（引用・名称）
concepts.def: A casual spoken form of to, to iu, or to wa used for quotations, hearsay, topic marking, and names.

concepts.name: 〜てほしい
concepts.def: Expresses the wish that the listener or another person perform an action.

concepts.name: ～てみる
concepts.def: Expresses trying an action in order to see what result it produces.

concepts.name: ～やすい
concepts.def: Indicates that an action is easy to perform or that a state is likely to occur.

concepts.name: 意志形＋と思う
concepts.def: Expresses the speaker's intention or plan to perform an action from now on.

concepts.name: 〜でも
concepts.def: Indicates that even if the preceding condition holds, the result differs from what would normally be expected.

concepts.name: 〜とか〜とか（例示列挙）
concepts.def: Lists several representative examples and indicates that other items or actions of the same kind also exist.

concepts.name: 〜ところ（直前・進行中・直後）
concepts.def: Indicates the stage immediately before, during, or immediately after an action.

concepts.name: 疑問詞＋〜ても（包括）
concepts.def: Leaves a person, object, place, time, or other item unspecified and indicates that every item in that range is acceptable or produces the same result.

concepts.name: 〜ことになる
concepts.def: Expresses that something is decided or comes about due to a decision or circumstances beyond the speaker's will. Koto ni natte iru describes an established rule or schedule.

concepts.name: 〜ようになる
concepts.def: Expresses a change in an ability, habit, or state compared with before.

concepts.name: 〜ばかり（限定・反復偏重）
concepts.def: Limits the scope to one thing or describes an excessive tendency to repeat the same action.

concepts.name: 〜みたいだ／〜みたいに／〜みたいなN
concepts.def: Conversationally expresses a guess based on appearance or circumstances, or says that a person or thing resembles something else.

concepts.name: ～そうだ（様態）
concepts.def: Expresses a judgment from appearance or circumstances that a state or event seems likely.

concepts.name: 〜そう［伝聞］
concepts.def: Reports information heard from another person or obtained from news and similar sources.

concepts.name: 〜ため（に）（原因・理由）
concepts.def: Presents the cause or reason for an event in a somewhat formal style.

concepts.name: ～ために
concepts.def: Expresses the purpose of an intentional action and the preparation or effort made to achieve it.

concepts.name: 〜てくる（往復を伴う移動）
concepts.def: Expresses movement toward the speaker or another reference point, or going elsewhere to perform an action and then returning to that point.

concepts.name: 〜てくる（状態・時間的変化）
concepts.def: Expresses a change that has developed from the past to the present or has begun to emerge.

concepts.name: 〈受け身形〉
concepts.def: A verb form indicating that the subject is affected by another person's action or by an event.

concepts.name: 〜おわる
concepts.def: Expresses carrying an action through to completion.

concepts.name: 〜がする
concepts.def: Expresses perceiving a sound, smell, taste, sensation, or similar impression.

concepts.name: 〜がる
concepts.def: Describes a third person's emotion, sensation, or desire as it appears outwardly through that person's expression or behavior.

concepts.name: 〜ずに
concepts.def: Expresses proceeding to another action or state without performing the first action.

concepts.name: 〜だす
concepts.def: Expresses an action or change beginning suddenly or with force.

concepts.name: 〜つづける
concepts.def: Expresses continuing an action or state without stopping midway.

concepts.name: 〜たらどうか
concepts.def: Responds to the listener's situation by suggesting or advising that they try a particular action.

concepts.name: 〜たほうがいい／〜ないほうがいい
concepts.def: Advises the listener to take a desirable action or avoid an undesirable one.

concepts.name: 〜ても／でもかまわない
concepts.def: Indicates that a presented option or condition is acceptable, or that not performing the action is also acceptable.

concepts.name: 〜ことがある（時々起こる）
concepts.def: Expresses that an event or action sometimes occurs depending on the circumstances.

concepts.name: 〜（さ）せる［使役］
concepts.def: Expresses making another person perform an action or allowing that person to perform it.

concepts.name: 使役受身形／〜（さ）せられる
concepts.def: Expresses being compelled or instructed by someone else to perform an action, regardless of one's wishes.

concepts.name: 〜すぎ
concepts.def: Indicates that a degree or quantity exceeds an appropriate limit.

concepts.name: ～にくい
concepts.def: Indicates that an action is difficult because of an object's properties, the circumstances, or another external factor.

concepts.name: 〜らしい（伝聞・推定）
concepts.def: Makes a likely inference based on information heard from others or on indirect evidence.

concepts.name: 〜らしい（典型性）
concepts.def: Indicates that a person or thing displays qualities or characteristics considered typical and appropriate for it.

concepts.name: 〜という
concepts.def: Places the specific content of a statement, piece of information, or fact before to iu to explain the noun that follows.

concepts.name: 〜まま（状態を変えない）
concepts.def: Expresses that a state remains unchanged or that another action is performed while that state continues.

concepts.name: ～ばよかった
concepts.def: Looks back on an action that was not actually performed and expresses regret that it would have been better to do it.

concepts.name: 動詞可能形
concepts.def: Expresses the ability to perform an action or the situational possibility of doing so.

concepts.name: 〜つもりだ（予定・意志）
concepts.def: Expresses a plan or intention that the speaker has decided to carry out.

concepts.name: 〜はじめる
concepts.def: Expresses the beginning of an action or change.

concepts.name: 〜ていく
concepts.def: From the present as a reference point, expresses continuing an action or a state or quality changing toward the future.

concepts.name: 〜てあげる
concepts.def: Expresses that the speaker or someone in the speaker's group performs an action for another person.

concepts.name: 〜てくれる
concepts.def: Presents an action performed by someone else for the speaker or the speaker's group as a benefit received.

concepts.name: 〜てもらう
concepts.def: Expresses having another person perform an action and receiving the benefit of that action.

concepts.name: 〜なければならない／〜なくてはいけない／〜ないといけない（義務・必要）
concepts.def: Expresses a necessity or obligation to perform an action because of a rule or situation. The three forms are similar in meaning, and nai to ikenai is also common in conversation.

concepts.name: 〜までに
concepts.def: Sets a deadline and indicates that an action must be completed before that point.

concepts.name: 〜ようだ（推量・状況判断）
concepts.def: Expresses the speaker's inference or judgment based on observed circumstances or clues.

concepts.name: 〜あいだ
concepts.def: Expresses the span of time during which a state or action continues.

concepts.name: 〜たことがある／ない（経験）
concepts.def: Expresses whether someone has ever experienced an action from the past up to the present.

concepts.name: 〜中（に）
concepts.def: Indicates that an activity is currently in progress or that something occurs within a specified deadline or period.

concepts.name: 〜てもいい（許可）
concepts.def: Grants permission to perform an action. In question form, it asks for permission.

concepts.name: 〜てはいけない／〜てはだめ（禁止）
concepts.def: Indicates that an action is prohibited by a rule or social judgment.

concepts.name: 〜のに（時間・費用・用途・評価の基準）
concepts.def: States the time, cost, or tool required to perform an action, or gives an evaluation of that action.

concepts.name: 〜ようだ／〜ようなN／〜ように（比喩・類似）
concepts.def: Compares a person, object, or appearance to something else and expresses a similar quality or manner.

concepts.name: ～ように
concepts.def: Expresses an action performed with the goal of acquiring an ability or achieving a desirable state.

concepts.name: 〜より〜（の）ほう
concepts.def: Compares two things and indicates that one has a higher degree or evaluation than the reference item.

concepts.name: 命令形（基礎体系）
concepts.def: A verb form used to strongly demand that someone perform an action. It appears on signs, in sports, in emergencies, and in quotations.

concepts.name: 〜ことができる（可能）
concepts.def: Expresses the ability to perform an action or that the action is possible under the circumstances or rules.

concepts.name: ～たら
concepts.def: Expresses what happens if a condition is met or after a particular event occurs.

concepts.name: ～ので
concepts.def: Presents the preceding content as a cause or reason and gently explains the result or judgment that follows.

concepts.name: 〜のです／〜んです（事情説明・背景提示）
concepts.def: Explains circumstances, reasons, or background information, or asks for an explanation of a situation. N desu is the conversational form.

concepts.name: 疑問詞＋か（埋め込み疑問）
concepts.def: Uses ka to package a question containing a question word and embed it in a sentence with verbs such as wakaru, shiru, or tazuneru.

concepts.name: 〜と［条件］
concepts.def: Expresses a result that occurs naturally or inevitably whenever a condition is met.

concepts.name: 〜と思う（意見・判断）
concepts.def: Expresses the speaker's opinion, judgment, or prediction about a matter.

concepts.name: なかなか〜ない
concepts.def: Indicates that an expected action or state is not easily realized.

concepts.name: 〜さ（程度の名詞化）
concepts.def: Turns the quality or degree expressed by an adjective into a noun that can be measured or compared.

concepts.name: ～なさい
concepts.def: Expresses an instruction or command to perform an action and is often used by someone of higher status toward someone of lower status.

concepts.name: 見える／〜のが見える（自発的知覚）
concepts.def: Expresses that a person, object, or event naturally enters one's field of vision and can be seen regardless of intention.

concepts.name: 聞こえる／〜のが聞こえる（自発的知覚）
concepts.def: Expresses that a sound or voice naturally reaches one's ears and can be heard regardless of intention.

concepts.name: 〜をいただく／〜ていただく（謙譲的受領・受益）
concepts.def: Humbly and politely expresses receiving an object from a superior or having a superior perform an action for oneself.

concepts.name: 〜をくださる／〜てくださる（尊敬的授与・恩恵）
concepts.def: Respectfully expresses that a superior gives something to the speaker or the speaker's group, or performs an action for their benefit.

concepts.name: 〜をさしあげる／〜てさしあげる（謙譲的授与）
concepts.def: Humbly expresses that the speaker or someone in the speaker's group gives something to, or acts for, a superior or another person deserving respect.

concepts.name: 〜ずつ（均等配分・反復）
concepts.def: Expresses distributing the same quantity to each recipient or an action or change progressing by a fixed amount at a time.

concepts.name: 〜させてください（許可・申し出）
concepts.def: Politely asks permission or offers to allow the speaker to perform an action.

concepts.name: 〜てくれませんか／〜てもらえませんか／〜ていただけませんか（丁寧な依頼）
concepts.def: Uses a question form to politely ask someone to perform an action.

concepts.name: 〜て／〜くて／〜で（理由・原因）
concepts.def: Presents the preceding action or state as a cause or reason and follows it with the resulting outcome.

concepts.name: 禁止（〜な）
concepts.def: Adds na to a verb's dictionary form to strongly order someone not to perform the action. It is used on signs, in emergencies, and for forceful warnings.

concepts.name: 〜たらいい／〜といい（希望・助言）
concepts.def: Expresses a wish for a desirable state to come about or gives advice or a suggestion about a desirable action.

concepts.name: 意志形
concepts.def: Expresses the speaker's intention or proposes doing an action together with someone close to the speaker.

sentences.ja: この<ruby>店<rt>みせ</rt></ruby>は<ruby>高<rt>たか</rt></ruby>いですが、<ruby>料<rt>りょう</rt></ruby><ruby>理<rt>り</rt></ruby>はおいしいです。
sentences.plain: この店は高いですが、料理はおいしいです。
sentences.en: This restaurant is expensive, but the food is delicious.

sentences.ja: <ruby>日<rt>に</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt>ほん</rt></ruby><ruby>語<rt>ご</rt></ruby>は<ruby>難<rt>むずか</rt></ruby>しいけど、おもしろいです。
sentences.plain: 日本語は難しいけど、おもしろいです。
sentences.en: Japanese is difficult, but it's interesting.

sentences.ja: <ruby>今日<rt>きょう</rt></ruby>は<ruby>日<rt>にち</rt></ruby><ruby>曜<rt>よう</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt>び</rt></ruby>だけれど、<ruby>仕<rt>し</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt>ごと</rt></ruby>があります。
sentences.plain: 今日は日曜日だけれど、仕事があります。
sentences.en: Today is Sunday, but I have work to do.

sentences.ja: <ruby>雨<rt>あめ</rt></ruby>が<ruby>降<rt>ふ</rt></ruby>っていますが、<ruby>予<rt>よ</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt>てい</rt></ruby>どおり<ruby>出<rt>で</rt></ruby>かけます。
sentences.plain: 雨が降っていますが、予定どおり出かけます。
